children.value: > Fact From Story India will face New Zealand in the ongoing World Cup semi-final match at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai on Wednesday (November 15).
> > Fact From Story This is the seventh time India have entered into the last-four stage of the 50-over World Cup.
> > > Fact From Story Eight years later, they were again in last four at the 2011 World Cup as hosts, and repeated their feat in 2015, 2019, and 2023.
> > > Fact From Story India first entered semifinals of the World Cup at the 1983 Prudential Cup in England, where they emerged as the tournament winners.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Each time a team enters the semi-finals, it adds to the total number of times they have entered the semi-finals.
> > Commonsense Knowledge The "last-four stage" of a world cup is the semi-finals.
> Commonsense Knowledge A semi-final match determines which team will advance to the next round.
